leaves.name: shimuraThm1Printed
leaves.doc: r16-shimura73, printed form (existential): Shimura, On the factors of the jacobian variety of a modular function field, J. Math. Soc. Japan 25 (1973), 523-544, Thm 1 (pp. 526-527 per the locator audit row R16; UNVERIFIED here). For a newform f in S_2(Gamma_1(N)) with nebentypus chi and J = J_1(N) (IsJ1): K_f is a number field, and there are A over Q, a surjection pi : J -> A and theta : K_f -> End^0(A) with dim A = [K_f : Q]; if the span of the conjugates of f is Fricke-stable (FrickeStable, W_N = TauCeti.frickeGL), the charpoly over Q_l of arithmetic Frobenius at p on V_l(A) is the rational polynomial prod_{iota : K_f -> C} (X^2 - iota(a_p) X + iota(chi(p)) p), for all p outside a finite set and not dividing N l (EulerIdentity). Weaker than the print: A existential (no Hecke action named), exceptional set unspecified.
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (Shimura 1973 Thm 1, unconditional clauses and the Euler-factor clause under Fricke-stability, existential form); locator UNVERIFIED (pp. 526-527 from the locator audit; the Euler clause's exceptional set and its Gamma0/Fricke premise not read here)
leaves.source: Shimura, On the factors of the jacobian variety of a modular function field, J. Math. Soc. Japan 25 (1973), 523-544, Theorem 1 (pp. 526-527, locator audit row R16); cited by diophantine_zq.tex (shimura-factors)

leaves.name: conjNewform
leaves.doc: r16-shimura73, step not covered by the manuscript's two citations: a cusp form g in S_2(Gamma_1(N)) whose coefficients are sigma(a_n(f)) for a newform f and a field embedding sigma : K_f -> C is a newform (for some character). Needed to apply Li's formula to every conjugate. Shimura 1971 Thm 3.52 and Galois stability of the new space (numbers UNVERIFIED).

leaves.name: shimuraTotalToComponents
leaves.doc: r16-shimura73, KNOWN ISSUE (source issue raised with the owner; not in the manuscript, not in Li or Shimura 1973): for a quotient pi : J_1(N) ->> A of dimension [K_f : Q] with a K_f-action whose Euler factors are prod_iota (X^2 - iota(a_p) X + iota(chi(p)) p) (EulerIdentity), some action theta' makes every iota-component of V_l(A) carry trace iota(a_p) and determinant iota(chi(p)) p at every p not dividing N l. The manuscript's step 'Euler-factor identity, therefore r_5 is a constituent of the Tate module of A_f' needs this (or the Eichler-Shimura relation on A_f with theta the Hecke action).
